title: GAVAGAI: Referential Alignment for Infant-Scale Vision-Language Models via Balanced Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2611.00319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A child learns which words name which things from roughly 100 million words of input. Vision-language models trained at a comparable scale bind words to referents far less reliably, and we argue that part of the gap is structural: the usual next-token captioning objective has no variable standing for "this word refers to that region," so training applies no direct pressure to ground words. We add such a variable by treating each scene as a small assignment problem between the content words heard and the regions seen, solved as entropic optimal transport under two constraints. First, a word may be assigned to a special NOTHING column instead of any region, which matters because most content words in caregiver speech do not name anything visible. Second, no region may receive more than a bounded share of the assignment mass, a capacity constraint that encodes mutual exclusivity. The alignment step costs about eight Sinkhorn iterations, sma

translated_title: GAVAGAI：通过平衡最优传输实现婴儿尺度视觉-语言模型的指称对齐
translated_abstract: 儿童从大约一亿词的输入中学会哪些词指称哪些事物。在相当规模数据上训练的视觉-语言模型将词与所指对象绑定的可靠性要低得多，我们认为这种差距部分是结构性的：通常的下一词元图像描述目标中不存在代表“这个词指称那个区域”的变量，因此训练过程对词语落地没有施加任何直接压力。我们通过把每个场景视为一个在听到的实义词与看到的区域之间的小型分配问题来引入这样一个变量，并以熵正则化最优传输在两个约束下求解。第一，一个词可以被分配到一个特殊的NOTHING列而非任何区域，这一点很重要，因为照护者话语中的大多数实义词并不命名任何可见之物。第二，任何区域所接收的分配质量不得超过一个有界份额，这一容量约束编码了互斥性。对齐步骤大约只需八次Sinkhorn迭代（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出GAVAGAI方法，将词语-区域对齐建模为带有NOTHING空列和区域容量约束的熵正则化最优传输分配问题，从而以约八次Sinkhorn迭代的低成本为婴儿尺度的视觉-语言模型提供直接的指称对齐监督。
en_tdlr: GAVAGAI frames word-to-region alignment as an entropic optimal transport assignment problem with a special NOTHING column and a capacity constraint encoding mutual exclusivity, providing direct referential grounding supervision for infant-scale vision-language models at a cost of only about eight Sinkhorn iterations.
